# FEMIC North Island Instance

> Agent-facing index for FEMIC North Island Instance. Read the linked pages before you change the project.

## Start here

- [Home](index.html): the documentation home for the project.
- [API reference](api/index.html): every public function, with its parameters, types, and return values.

## Guides

- [North Island AOI](aoi.html): the Basecamp AOI rule, public boundary sources, review checks, and the CFA caveat.
- [Model build](model-build.html): the FreshForge workflow, FEMIC-to-ws4 chain, commands, and runtime boundary.
- [Retention policy](retention-policy.html): the v0.2.0 decision to retain the two lowest-yield AUs, with THLB and pro-rated AAC evidence.
- [Release notes](release-notes.html): the v0.2.0 instance release summary and compatibility notes.
- [Web UI](web-ui.html): the ws4 serve command, EPSG:3005 handling, and the verification checks.

- [VDYP runtime boundary](../notes/reference/vdyp-runtime.md): Wine, the batch timeout evidence, and the provisional auto-sampling workaround.
